auth.description:
To get your Synthesia API Key:

1. Go to the upper right corner of the Synthesia application and click on your account.
2. Select **Integrations**
3. Click on **Add** to add a new Synthesia API key.
4. Copy this key using the 3-dot button on the right side of your API key.
5. Paste it below.

**Note:** When you create an API key it will belong to your account, not the workspace.

templateId.description: Select the template to use for video creation

templateData.description: Key-value pairs for template variables. Keys must match variable names in the template (case-sensitive)

test.description: If enabled, creates a test video with a watermark

visibility.description: The visibility setting for the video

brandKitId.description: The ID of the brand kit to use (use "workspace_default" for default)

aiMetadata.description: Submits a video-generation job to Synthesia from an existing template, passing template-variable values as case-sensitive key-value pairs. Choose this when the user wants a video built from a pre-designed template rather than authored scene-by-scene; requires a valid template ID. Each call queues a new video, so it is not idempotent. Enable test mode to produce a watermarked preview.

createVideo.name: createVideo
createVideo.description: Create a video within your Synthesia account with one or more scenes

input_scriptText.description: An array of scenes to be included in the video

input_scriptAudioUrl.description: URL of the audio file to be used for the video script (optional)

input_avatar.description: The avatar to be used in the video https://docs.synthesia.io/reference/avatars)

input_background.description: Background for the video. Can be a stock background, custom asset ID, or URL

test.description: If enabled, creates a test video with a watermark

title.description: Custom title for the video (displayed on the share page)

description.description: Custom description for the video (displayed on the share page)

brandKitId.description: The ID of the brand kit to use (use "workspace_default" for default)

pushServiceUrl.description: Webhook URL for push notifications when video completes

aiMetadata.description: Submits a video-generation job to Synthesia built from a text script, a chosen avatar, and a background (stock preset, custom asset ID, or URL). Choose this to generate a video from scratch from raw script text rather than from a saved template; script text and avatar are required. Each call queues a new video, so it is not idempotent. Enable test mode for a watermarked preview, or set a webhook URL to be notified when the video completes.

newVideoReady.name: newVideoReady
newVideoReady.description: Trigger when a new video is completed in Synthesia

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Synthesia video finishes rendering and becomes ready (the video.completed event), delivered via a registered webhook. Represents a single completed video; use it to act on a video once generation has finished.

nl.Create AI videos from text in minutes us: Maak AI video's van tekst in minuten met behulp van Synthesie
nl.\nTo get your Synthesia API Key:\n\n1. G:
Om je Synthesia API Key te verkrijgen:

1. Ga naar de rechterbovenhoek van de Synthesia toepassing en klik op je account.
2. Selecteer **Integraties**
3. Klik op **Toevoegen** om een nieuwe Synthesia API-sleutel toe te voegen.
4. Kopieer deze sleutel met behulp van de 3-puntjes knop aan de rechterkant van je API-sleutel.
5. Plak deze hieronder.

**Opmerking:** Wanneer u een API-sleutel aanmaakt, behoort deze tot uw account, niet tot de werkruimte.

de.Create AI videos from text in minutes us: Erstellen Sie KI-Videos aus Text in Minuten mit Synthesia
de.\nTo get your Synthesia API Key:\n\n1. G:
Um deinen Synthesia API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:

1. Gehe in die obere rechte Ecke der Synthesia Anwendung und klicke auf dein Konto.
2. Wählen Sie **Integrations**
3. Klicken Sie auf **Hinzufügen** um einen neuen Synthesia API-Schlüssel hinzuzufügen.
4. Kopieren Sie diesen Schlüssel mit der 3-Punkt-Schaltfläche auf der rechten Seite Ihres API-Schlüssels.
Fügen Sie ihn unten ein.

**Notiz:** Wenn Sie einen API-Schlüssel erstellen, gehört er zu Ihrem Konto, nicht zum Arbeitsbereich.
